questions.text: In a certain code language, 'PAPER' is written as 'QZSDQ'. Following the same pattern, how will 'PENCIL' be written in that language?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Observe the first two letters 'P'->'Q' (+1) and 'A'->'Z' (-1). The pattern alternates between +1 and -1. Apply this alternating pattern to 'PENCIL' without full calculation: P(+1)=Q, E(-1)=D, N(+1)=O, C(-1)=B, I(+1)=J, L(-1)=K. Result: QDOBJK. Step-by-step: Write alphabet positions. P(16)->Q(17) [+1]. A(1)->Z(26) [-1]. P(16)->Q(17) [+1]. E(5)->D(4) [-1]. R(18)->S(19) [+1]. Pattern confirmed: +1, -1, +1, -1, +1. Apply to P-E-N-C-I-L: P+1=Q, E-1=D, N+1=O, C-1=B, I+1=J, L-1=K. Code is QDOBJK.

questions.text: Find the unit digit of the expression \(7^{95} + 3^{58} - 2^{47}\).
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use cyclicity of unit digits (cycle of 4). \(7^{95} ightarrow 7^3\) (unit 3), \(3^{58} ightarrow 3^2\) (unit 9), \(2^{47} ightarrow 2^3\) (unit 8). Unit digit = 3 + 9 - 8 = 4. Full: \(95 \bmod 4 = 3\), \(58 \bmod 4 = 2\), \(47 \bmod 4 = 3\). \(7^3=343\), \(3^2=9\), \(2^3=8\). Sum = 3 + 9 - 8 = 4.

questions.text: Choose the correct passive form of the given sentence: They have been building the bridge for two years.

options.label: A
options.text: The bridge has been being built by them for two years.

options.label: B
options.text: The bridge is being built by them for two years.

options.label: C
options.text: The bridge has been built by them for two years.

options.label: D
options.text: The bridge was being built by them for two years.

questions.solution: Shortcut: Identify the tense (Present Perfect Continuous). Passive formula: Object + has/have + been + being + V3. Since 'bridge' is singular, use 'has'. Worked Solution: Active Voice: Subject (They) + have been building (Present Perfect Continuous) + Object (the bridge). Passive Voice: Object (The bridge) + has been being built (Present Perfect Continuous Passive) + by + Subject (them). The time phrase 'for two years' remains unchanged.

questions.text: Pointing to a photograph, a woman says, "He is the only son of the only daughter-in-law of my husband's father." How is the man in the photograph related to the woman?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Break from end. 'My husband's father' = Woman's Father-in-law. 'Only daughter-in-law of Father-in-law' = Woman herself (assuming monogamy). 'Only son of Woman' = Woman's Son. Full Solution: 1. Husband's Father -> Father-in-law. 2. Only Daughter-in-law of Father-in-law -> The Woman (speaker). 3. Only Son of the Woman -> Her Son. Answer: Son.

questions.text: Which of the following was the immediate cause for the launch of the Civil Disobedience Movement in 1930?

options.label: B
options.text: Rejection of the Nehru Report by the British

options.label: C
options.text: Viceroy Irwin's refusal to accept the 'Eleven Demands' presented by Gandhi

options.label: D
options.text: Passing of the Government of India Act, 1935

questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate options based on chronology. Simon Commission (1927) and Nehru Report (1928) predate the movement but were not the immediate trigger. The Government of India Act 1935 came after the movement. Gandhi presented 11 demands to Irwin on Jan 31, 1930; their rejection led directly to the Dandi March on March 12, 1930. Worked Solution: The Civil Disobedience Movement was launched after the British Viceroy Lord Irwin failed to respond positively to Gandhi's 'Eleven Point Ultimatum' (including abolition of salt tax, reduction of land revenue, etc.) by the deadline of January 31, 1930.

questions.text: Pointing to a lady in the photograph, Rajesh said, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the lady related to Rajesh?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Grandfather's only son is Rajesh's father; the daughter of his father is Rajesh's sister (or himself, but the person is a lady). Full solution: Identify the only son of Rajesh's grandfather – that is Rajesh's father. The lady is described as the daughter of that father, making her the sister of Rajesh. Hence the correct relation is sister.

questions.text: In a certain code language, 'ACF' is written as 'PRU'. Following the same pattern, how will 'EHK' be written in that language?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Find the constant shift by comparing the first letters: A (1) → P (16) gives +15; verify C→R and F→U also give +15. Apply +15 to each letter of EHK: E(5)+15=20(T), H(8)+15=23(W), K(11)+15=26(Z) → TWZ. Full solution: The mapping is a Caesar cipher with a shift of 15 positions forward in the alphabet. Checking each pair confirms the shift is consistent. Adding 15 to the positions of E, H, K yields T, W, Z respectively, so the coded word is TWZ.

questions.text: A mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 7:3. After adding 10 litres of water, the ratio becomes 7:5. What was the initial quantity of the mixture?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Let milk = 7x, water = 3x. (7x)/(3x+10) = 7/5 → 35x = 21x + 70 → x = 5 → initial mixture = 10x = 50 L. Step: Set up the proportion equation and solve for x.

questions.text: The Bhakra Nangal Project is a joint venture of the Central Government and which of the following groups of states?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate pairs (Options A, B, C). Major inter-state river valley projects in India (like Bhakra Nangal on Sutlej) typically involve three or more beneficiary states. The Bhakra Nangal Agreement (1959) was signed between the Centre, Punjab, Haryana, and Rajasthan. Worked Solution: The Bhakra Nangal Dam on the Sutlej River is a multipurpose project. The Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB) manages it, with partner states being Punjab, Haryana, and Rajasthan (successor states to the original signatories Punjab, PEPSU, and Rajasthan).

questions.text: Who among the following Governor-Generals is known as the 'Father of Local Self Government in India' due to his resolution of 1882?
questions.solution: Shortcut/Trick: Associate 'Ripon' with 'Reform' (Local Self Govt Resolution 1882, Factory Act 1881, Ilbert Bill 1883). Elimination: Lord Lytton is known for repressive policies (Vernacular Press Act, Arms Act). Lord Curzon for Partition of Bengal (1905) and Universities Act. Lord Mayo started financial decentralization (1870) but Ripon institutionalized elected local bodies.

questions.text: The Tenth Schedule of the Constitution of India, which contains provisions for disqualification on the ground of defection, was added by which Constitutional Amendment Act?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate the 'Mini Constitution' (42nd), Panchayati Raj (73rd), and the later strengthening amendment (91st). The 52nd Amendment Act, 1985, originally inserted the Tenth Schedule. The 91st Amendment (2003) later omitted the 'split' provision. Full Solution: The Anti-Defection Law was introduced by the Rajiv Gandhi government via the 52nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1985, adding the Tenth Schedule toc urb political defections. The 91st Amendment Act, 2003, further tightened the law by deleting the provision allowing splits (1/3rd members) and mandating that defectors resign and seek re-election.

questions.text: Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error: Neither the principal nor the teachers was present at the meeting.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Proximity Rule (Verb agrees with the nearest subject). In 'Neither...Nor' / 'Either...Or' structures, the verb matches the number/person of the second subject ('teachers' - Plural). Hence, 'was' (Singular) is incorrect; it should be 'were'. Worked Solution: The sentence uses the correlative conjunction 'Neither...Nor'. Subject 1: 'The principal' (Singular). Subject 2: 'The teachers' (Plural). The verb must agree with the subject closest to it (Subject 2). Since 'teachers' is plural, the correct verb is 'were present'. The error lies in segment C ('was present').

questions.text: The marked price of an article is 40% above its cost price. A shopkeeper allows two successive discounts of 10% and 20% on the marked price. What is the profit or loss percentage?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Equivalent single discount for 10% and 20% = 10 + 20 - (10×20/100) = 28%. SP = MP × (100-28)/100 = 1.4×CP × 0.72 = 1.008×CP. Profit = 0.8%. Full: Let CP = ₹100. MP = ₹140. After 10% discount, price = ₹126. After 20% discount, SP = ₹100.8. Profit % = (0.8/100)×100 = 0.8%.

questions.text: Change the following sentence into Indirect Speech: He said to me, "Please help me in this matter."

options.label: A
options.text: He ordered me to help him in this matter.

options.label: B
options.text: He requested me to help him in that matter.

options.label: C
options.text: He asked me if I could help him in that matter.

options.label: D
options.text: He told me to help him in this matter.

questions.solution: Shortcut: 'Please' + Imperative → Reporting verb changes to 'requested' + 'to' + V1. Change 'said to' to 'requested'. Pronouns: 'me' (listener) stays 'me'; 'me' (speaker) becomes 'him'. Demonstrative 'this' becomes 'that'. Worked Solution: Direct: He said to me, "Please help me in this matter." The word 'Please' indicates a request. Reporting verb 'said to' becomes 'requested'. Imperative 'help' changes to infinitive 'to help'. Pronoun 'me' (object of help) refers to the speaker (He), so it becomes 'him'. 'This' changes to 'that'. Result: He requested me to help him in that matter.

questions.text: A shopkeeper marks an article 40% above its cost price and allows a discount of 15% on the marked price. What is his profit percent?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Profit% = Markup% - Discount% - (Markup% × Discount%)/100 = 40 - 15 - (40×15)/100 = 19%. Full: Let CP = ₹100; MP = ₹140; SP = 85% of 140 = ₹119; Profit = ₹19 → 19%.
